_comment_record_hz: Section H's mandatory high-risk list: "Mandatory for the highest-risk segments: S01+S02 (opening), S04 (tournament), X02 (build), X01 (controller/menu stress), CB-06 + CB-07 + Warden (representative combat), every band handoff +/-60 s (region transitions), X05 (save/load), S10 (finale)." This segment is on that list, so its baseline is 0.5 Hz rather than the 0.1 Hz journey default. Set by the Gate F coordinator, not a transcription choice. Cost is measured, not assumed: one readback+encode at 1920x1080 is 126.5 ms mean on this container, which at 0.5 Hz amortises to 1.054 ms/frame -- over the ~1 ms/frame line section 3 asks about. Section H requires the density here anyway; the overhead note carries the number so a reader can see what the density cost rather than being told it was free.
title: Save and session lifecycle (protocol E.8)
_source: ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md E.8, transcribed mechanically per ralph/GATE_F_INSTRUMENTATION_REQUEST.md section 6. Entry saves per protocol B: every S0n-exit.
_lane: SEGMENT_SCHEMA.md lists `journey` and `diag` as the lane values. This segment is neither: protocol 0.1 names two lanes, JOURNEY (S01-S10) and STUDY/DIAG (X01-X08), and only the segments prefixed DIAG- inside that second lane may take a shortcut. `study` is that distinction written down rather than collapsed into `diag`, which would read as permission this segment does not have. The field is informational either way -- the per-step `diag` flag is what actually permits a shortcut, and no step here carries one.
_slots: scripts/save/save_game.gd has 5 slots. Slot 0 is autosave; slot 4 is the segment handoff slot; slots 1-3 are the player slots, and E.8 requires all three exercised across the run. This segment rotates 1, 2, 3 across the nine journey exit saves.
_no_teleport: X05 is not a DIAG segment and contains no teleport step.
_gap: SEGMENT_SCHEMA.md's assert checks cover position (near), party (party_size), flags (flag_set), tracked objective (objective_is) and region (region_is). Satiety, time of day and placed buildings have no assert check, so those three legs of E.6.13's checklist are recorded as event fields (player.satiety, clock_hour, inventory) and read by Phase B rather than verdicted by the harness. Named here rather than quietly dropped.

steps.title: what this segment is

args.text: E.8: 'From every journey exit save: save via tab (all 3 player slots exercised across the run), quit to title, load, verify restoration (checklist in E.6.13); measure duration_ms for each save and load; boot-to-title and title-to-world durations; autosave (slot 0) observed firing and loading; load-the-wrong-older-slot check (loading S03-exit after playing to S06 must restore the older state cleanly, not merge). Title-screen New Game over an existing save must not destroy slots without confirmation.'
